title: The Empty Office After Thirty Years

protagonist.name: Bhabesh Mukherjee
protagonist.role: Chief Accounts Documentation Officer, State Export House, Kolkata (1993–2024)
protagonist.coreConflict: The sudden evaporation of thirty-one years of structural importance into silence on the day of retirement.

counterpart.name: Sourav Datta
counterpart.dynamic: The young successor who cannot fathom why triplicate paper ledgers required three decades of devotion.

setting.primary: Cabin 402, 4th Floor, State Export House, Brabourne Road, Kolkata
setting.secondary: Ramu's tea corner under the neem tree; the 5:40 PM tram along Strand Road
setting.atmosphere: Fading afternoon light across dusty filing cabinets, hollow echo of cleared desk drawers, the smell of brown ledger paper

signatureObjects: The brass paperweight shaped like a maritime anchor presented in 2008 for fifteen years of service
The laminated identity card whose corner had been taped with cellotape in 2011
The blue ballpoint pen with dried red ink on the cap that had signed 14,000 shipment approvals
structuralMilestones: The final 09:15 AM arrival at Brabourne Road through the revolving brass door
The perfunctory tea-and-samosa farewell meeting in Conference Room B
Packing the cardboard box with 31 years of personal fragments
The hollow quiet of Cabin 402 once the nameplate is unfastened
The walk onto Brabourne Road at 5:30 PM into a city where no file is waiting
